name: Tacos de Papa
summary: Corn tortillas filled with cheesy mashed potato and pan-fried until crisp. Topped with shredded cabbage, salsa, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: green cabbage (use about a quarter, finely shredded)

instructions: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the cheese, cumin, and 1 tsp salt.
Blend or mash the tomatoes with the garlic, chili powder, and a pinch of salt for a quick salsa.
Warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking. Spread a heaping spoonful of potato on half of each and fold over. Pin with a toothpick if they spring open.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the tacos 2–3 minutes per side until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towel.
Serve four per person, topped with cabbage, salsa, and sour cream.

glutenFree.notes: Corn tortillas are naturally gluten-free, but a few brands add wheat flour. Check the label.

budgetNotes: Substitution: cheddar replaces queso fresco, which isn't reliably stocked at Ottawa chain stores. The taste changes: queso fresco is mild, milky and slightly salty, and crumbles without melting. Cheddar is sharper and melts into strings. If you find queso fresco or feta, crumble it on at the end instead.
The cabbage is priced as a whole head ($2.18), and you'll use about a quarter. The rest keeps for weeks. Use it in Pork and Cabbage Rice Bowls or Cabbage and Kielbasa Skillet.
Fry in batches. Crowding the pan makes them greasy instead of crisp.
Leftover mashed potatoes work as the filling.
